The qualitative S2 readily-remediable alternative and S3 bounded livelihood/organisational loss were independently tested: recovery is evidenced, but no additional material functional economic impairment supports S3. Numeric S2 remains controlling without invented final net loss. Independent relational and heightened-protection recognition tests completed.

retained_rows.assessment_basis: The AI-mediated executive video directly engages stakeholder awareness of interaction with AI. The police account describes real executives being impersonated to induce the transfer, with the victim discovering the scam later. Meaningful awareness was withheld in that interaction; this independently contradicts Section 1.3(ii), irrespective of voluntary status.

The synthetic executive video was presented as a genuine executive interaction before the victim transferred funds. The police account establishes later discovery rather than advance disclosure. The specific NIST requirement to document GAI interaction to the user before interactive activity therefore did not hold in this bounded interaction; organisational framework adoption is not required.

external_requirements.coverage_disposition: Existing independent identity disclosure, detector validation, source representation, contestability and protection outcomes retained at their distinct actors/evidence objects. Detector flagging is not whole-workflow containment; a company promise is not completed remediation. No missing relational standard is inferred where the class recognition conditions are not engaged.

evidence_gaps: Underlying private transactions, victim execution traces and individual consequences remain bounded by preserved source access.
Recovery effort is distinguished from restitution; quoted offers and requested payments from actual loss.
